await (async(page)=>{const check=(v,m)=>{if(!v)throw Error(m);},done=()=>page.locator('#maxwell-status').filter({hasText:'Physical-time history complete.'}).waitFor({timeout:30000});if(await page.locator('#maxwell-controls details').getAttribute('open')===null)await page.locator('#maxwell-controls details summary').click();const segments=JSON.parse(await page.locator('#maxwell-segments').inputValue());segments[0].duration=4;segments[0].samples=4;await page.locator('#maxwell-segments').fill(JSON.stringify(segments));await page.locator('#maxwell-start').fill('2');await page.locator('#maxwell-run').click();await done();check((await page.locator('#maxwell-summary').textContent()).includes('2–6 s'),'custom physical clock');const event=page.waitForEvent('download');await page.locator('#maxwell-export').click();await(await event).saveAs('/private/tmp/atlas-maxwell-main-atlas-v1/browser-history-edit.json');await page.locator('#maxwell-reset').click();await done();check(await page.locator('#maxwell-start').inputValue()==='0','reset restores clock');await page.locator('#maxwell-preset').selectOption('oedometer');await page.locator('#maxwell-run').click();await done();check((await page.locator('#maxwell-state').textContent()).includes('unresolved'),'mixed entry unresolved rate disclosure');await page.locator('#maxwell-component').selectOption({index:2});check((await page.locator('#maxwell-rate').textContent()).includes('Strain rate'),'rate axis');return {passed:true,custom_history_and_clock:true,reset_clock:true,mixed_entry_null_rate_disclosure:true,component_plot_switch:true,mobile:{viewport:await page.evaluate(()=>innerWidth),document:await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth)}};})(page);
